query: UNWIND [{paper_key: 'KTQS6SDD', arxiv_id: '1212.2839', doi: '', title: 'Quantum Field as a quantum cellular automaton: the Dirac free evolution in one dimension', year: '2012', url: 'http://arxiv.org/abs/1212.2839', title_key: 'quantumfieldasaquantumcellularautomatonthediracfreeevolutioninonedimension', authors: ['Alessandro Bisio', 'Giacomo Mauro DAriano', 'Alessandro Tosini']}, {paper_key: '8RZQA73D', arxiv_id: '2404.09840', doi: '10.1103/physreva.110.042418', title: 'Dirac quantum walk on tetrahedra', year: '2024', url: 'http://arxiv.org/abs/2404.09840', title_key: 'diracquantumwalkontetrahedra', authors: ['Ugo Nzongani', 'Nathanael Eon', 'Ivan Marquez-Martin', 'Armando Perez', 'Giuseppe Di Molfetta', 'Pablo Arrighi']}] AS row MERGE (paper:Paper {paper_key: row.paper_key}) SET paper.zotero_key = row.paper_key, paper.arxiv_id = row.arxiv_id, paper.doi = row.doi, paper.title = row.title, paper.abstract = coalesce(paper.abstract, ''), paper.year = row.year, paper.date = row.year, paper.url = row.url, paper.source = 'zotero', paper.item_type = 'preprint', paper.title_key = row.title_key, paper.updated_at = datetime() MERGE (c:Collection {collection_key: '9W59V3K9'}) ON CREATE SET c.name = 'null-edge-lit' MERGE (paper)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c) FOREACH (aname IN row.authors | MERGE (a:Author {name: aname}) MERGE (paper)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(a)) FOREACH (tname IN ['null-edge-program', 'archive-baseline-repair'] | MERGE (t:Tag {name: tname}) MERGE (paper)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t)) RETURN paper.paper_key AS paper_key, paper.arxiv_id AS arxiv_id, paper.doi AS doi, paper.title AS title ORDER BY arxiv_id
